children: Taiwan's economy should remain strong into 2027, says Lynn Song, ING Greater China chief economist, in a note. Exports in August continued to surge, with Taiwan remaining a key beneficiary of the ongoing tech investment boom. The island has recorded months of strong export order data, and ING's recent visit to Taiwan corporates shows artificial-intelligence beneficiaries continue to have full order books. The trade surplus will also continue to drive growth, Song says. ING forecasts 2026 and 2027 GDP growth for Taiwan at 11.1% and 7.2%, respectively. The economy expanded 8.76% in 2025.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
